name: Hizaki Suina
source:
The main heroine. A beautiful girl with silky silver hair and red eyes, petite but with a well-trained body and a very large bust. As the strongest "Prime Star" Solfina she was celebrated as a national hero and idol, until a conspiracy cost her everything and forced her to start over as an independent. Her goal is to free her home island, which has been overrun by the Seraxites.

A capable fighter, but expressionless, cool and marching to her own beat. She is not good at communicating and can be naive about the world. She is secretly confident in her own cuteness. Her hobby is training.

[From DLsite, translated]
